## Publication Information

**Date:** 1890

**Imprint:** <i>MP</i> (June 1890) 527-540

**Notes:** The story appeared under the name 'Joanna Harrison' but it is apparent from CMY's correspondence with A. D. Innes that the author was a [[person: 289]Miss Cheape], perhaps Harriette Cheape.
